reasoning: Recent coverage indicates Nebraska’s 2026 Senate race is unusually competitive for a strongly Republican state, but still leans toward the GOP. The clearest quantitative signal is Yahoo News’ updated battlegrounds piece giving a prediction of Pete Ricketts (R) +2, while IVN reports an Osborn +5 internal-style poll in a race where no survey shows the Republican pulling away; prediction-market and forecaster language (lean R) reinforce a modest Republican edge rather than a toss-up. The presidential context and structural data (Trump +20 in 2024, statewide PVI R+10) further support reading the current general-election environment as R-tilting even when the specific Senate polling snapshot is close.
